metadata.title: SpaceX Stock Is on a Good Run While Retail Investors Are Selling. What Gives?<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
SpaceX Stock Is on a Good Run While Retail Investors Are Selling. What Gives?
Elon Musk’s army of small, retail shareholders has helped prop up Tesla stock in the past. Many of those same retail shareholders now hold SpaceX.
